title: stachys iberica subsp. stenostachya
intro: Stachys iberica subsp. stenostachya, commonly known as Dwarf Woundwort or Turkish Iberis, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine, primarily for its wound-healing properties and as an antiseptic agent. The health benefits of Stachys iberica subsp. stenostachya include its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, attributed to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are present in its leaves and other plant parts.
